headline: 20 Years Later, Sofia Coppola’s ‘Marie Antoinette’ Is Back at Versailles
context: Once criticized for its modern soundtrack and pastel aesthetics, the director’s portrait of royal ennui is now being honored in the chateau where it was filmed.

sources.name: The New York Times
